## Requirements (canonical §6.2, the C1/Stage-4 row + heading text)

1. Multi-namespace service: `hh/`, `local/`, `exp/<experiment_id>/`, shared
   reverse-DNS namespaces; one identity model, one append-only name index,
   `(namespace, name)` unique across kinds.
2. Signer ownership: `NamespaceRecord.owners` = `[SignerRef | PrincipalRef]`;
   shared namespaces owned by an accepted signer
   (`TrustRootPolicy.accepted_signers`) or the administering principal; a
   non-owner `publish` is `NamespaceForbidden`.
3. `TrustRootPolicy` record lands (`{accepted_signers, require_signature_for,
   hash_only_ceiling}` — layered, definition-plane).
4. Third-party lifecycle: publish / deprecate / yank / revoke authorized by the
   namespace rules; `revoke` of another publisher's version needs namespace
   owner or administrator ≥ `principal`; always a `RevocationRecord`.
5. Third-party variant admission (AC-9): unsigned out-of-process → `resolved`,
   `summary.authority = external`, `placement ≥ subprocess_confined`;
   `in_process` → `LocalityInadmissible`; `require_signature_for ∋
   component_variant` → `quarantined` until a verified `pin`.
6. Revocation propagation (AC-10): `resolve(execute)` never returns `v` or any
   sealed definition in `StaleIndex[v]`; dependent rows annotated
   `depends_on_revoked`, never hidden.
7. General `import`/`export` (AC-11): `ForeignRegistryRef{system ∈
   {mcp_registry, acp_registry, marketplace, git, archive}, locator, digest?,
   label?}` → `foreign_import` records, quarantined by default, text legs
   `unverified`, `LossReport` ≥ {capabilities, conformance, trust legs,
   digest}; ACP `agent.json` → hosted participant-descriptor candidate, never
   a variant; `export` → `PluginManifest/1` + LossReport; export→import of a
   first-party variant recovers every field not declared lost.
8. `publisher_claim` represented at `review`; strict `probed` conformance mode
   (admissible, non-stale reports only; `publisher_claim` never satisfies).
9. Boundary: Group L `lab.registry.*` gains the general import/export surface
   (`lab.registry.export` flips `implemented`); canonical Json in/out; events
   flushed through the one fenced writer.
10. `removability(0…3)` unchanged (CC6).

| AC-R-2.10.2-9 | Third-party admission: resolved + `external` + confined; `in_process` → `LocalityInadmissible`; `require_signature_for ∋ component_variant` → `quarantined` until `pin`; declaration → no vector until `registry_ci` report |
| AC-R-2.10.2-10 | Revocation propagation: `resolve(execute)` never returns `v` or `StaleIndex[v]` members; dependent rows annotated `depends_on_revoked`, never hidden |
| AC-R-2.10.2-11 | Foreign import lossy-declared: ACP `agent.json` + MCP `server.json` → `quarantined` `foreign_import`s; digests only where the source carries one; `LossReport` ≥ {capabilities, conformance, trust legs, digest}; ACP → participant-descriptor candidate, never variant; export→import recovers every undeclared-lost field |
| removability(0…3) | `scripts/check-removability.sh` green, unchanged |

## Plan (implementation order)

1. `hh-identity::names` — `Namespace` generalised: `{Hh, Local, Experiment(String),
   Shared(String)}` (non-Copy; `as_str(&self) -> String`); grammar: `hh` |
   `local` | `exp/<id>` | reverse-DNS ≥2 labels. `history` takes `&Namespace`.
2. `hh-registry`: `TrustRootPolicy` record body + `RegistryRecord` arm +
   codecs; `ForeignImport.loss_report` becomes the structured `LossReport`
   (`{capabilities, conformance, trust_legs, digest, other}`) — the member was
   vocabulary-held at C0, its semantics land now.
3. `store.rs`: trust anchors (union of live `TrustRootPolicy.accepted_signers`),
   signer-ownership by *verified* attestation (`Signer(s)` anchor ⇒ attestation
   must anchor `s` and verify under `{s}` — the namespace record is the trust
   declaration for ownership), refined `publish`/`set_name_status`/`revoke`
   authorization, third-party variant `resolved` admission + `summary.authority
   ≤ external` cap, signature-required ⇒ `quarantined` until a verified
   `pin`/`signature`, `component_variant` alias → `variant` in
   `require_signature_for`, strict `probed` coverage, `publisher_claims`
   projection, namespace iteration over every registered spelling, namespace
   registration rules (grammar-checked, ≥ principal or self-certifying owner
   signer, no clobber of `hh`/`local`).
4. `foreign.rs` (new): `ForeignSystem` closed sum, `ForeignRef`, `LossReport`,
   `import` (per-system lifts — ACP→participant candidate, MCP `server.json`
   →manifest body, verbatim otherwise; digests only when supplied) and
   `export` → `PluginManifest/1` documents + loss reports.
5. `events.rs` + `hh-ledger/classes.rs`: `lifecycle.registry.imported`
   (spec §6.2 §6's family) + `system`/`locator` payload fields.
6. `hh-embed` + `hh-embed-schema`: `lab.registry.import` dispatches
   `{source, document}` vs `{listing}`; `lab.registry.export` goes live;
   `publisher_claims` on the resolved projection.
7. Tests, evidence, ADR, ledgers, PR.
